description: This file contains shell script functions and procedures for configuring and managing MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) network interfaces using the 'umbim' tool. It includes functions for initialization, setup, teardown, and handling network connection states, as well as parsing configuration data.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration with default parameters and options.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts a specific field value from the MBIM configuration string.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Performs the setup process for the MBIM interface, including device detection, registration, and network attachment.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper around _proto_mbim_setup that retries on failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Handles the teardown process for the MBIM interface, disconnecting and cleaning up state.
